articles.title: Quality Stock Investing: 8 mistakes that can ruin your portfolio and how to avoid them
articles.content: Building a portfolio of high-quality companies requires more than simply identifying good businesses. Lawrence A. Cunningham’s quality-investing framework highlights common mistakes such as overreliance on macro trends, overconfidence, ignoring debt and accounting red flags, and holding stocks despite deteriorating fundamentals.

articles.title: Warren Buffett turns 96: Top 10 investing lessons from the Oracle of Omaha
articles.content: As Warren Buffett turns 96 in his first birthday since stepping down as Berkshire Hathaway's CEO, the piece revisits the investing principles behind his six-decade run — patience, discipline, staying within his "circle of competence," and concentrating capital when conviction is high.

articles.title: Nifty weekly outlook: Nifty trapped in 23,900-24,750 range; fresh buying should remain selective
articles.content: Nifty ended the week lower after consolidating in a narrow range, with the broader technical structure remaining unchanged. The index moved between 24,076.85 and 24,378.60, while India VIX declined 4.64% to 10.68. Support remains at 23,900–24,000, while a cluster of moving averages continues to cap upside in the 24,400–24,750 zone.

articles.title: FPIs turn buyers for second straight month, invest Rs 30,919 cr in August
articles.content: During August, foreign portfolio investors added over Rs 30,000 crore to Indian equities, showcasing the ongoing trend of substantial market inflows for the second month in a row. This surge can be attributed to enhancing corporate earnings and a stable economic environment. Furthermore, easing global geopolitical tensions have aided investor optimism, yet uncertainties surrounding crude oil prices and US bond yields remain pressing issues.

articles.title: 7 of top 10 firms shed Rs 1.13 lakh cr in m-cap; Airtel, Reliance worst hit
articles.content: Last week observed a notable decline in market valuations, with seven out of the ten top firms witnessing a reduction of Rs 1.13 lakh crore. articles.title: Corporate actions this week: NTPC, Coal India among nearly 90 cos set to hit record dates for dividend payouts, bonus issues & stock splits

articles.title: Blackstone offers to sell up to 25% of India's Knowledge REIT for over $1 billion
articles.content: Blackstone is looking to sell a stake of up to 25.03 percent in Knowledge Realty Trust. This offer encompasses both a base stake and an oversubscription option. Since its listing in August 2025, the REIT has experienced moderate growth.

articles.title: Max Estates buys 85-acre land in Delhi to build projects, eyes Rs 10,000-12,000 cr revenue
articles.content: Max Estates has successfully acquired 84.71 acres in West Delhi for a whopping Rs 420 crore. By entering Delhi's housing market, Max Estates significantly enhances its land portfolio while ensuring robust future growth without immediate cash expenditure.

articles.title: Sebi bars Trafiksol ITS, its promoters from securities market for 1 year; slaps Rs 1.05 cr fine
articles.content: Sebi has taken decisive action against Trafiksol and its promoters, imposing a one-year ban from the securities market. The company and its directors face penalties totaling Rs 1.05 crore after being found in serious breach of regulations concerning financial disclosures and the allocation of IPO funds. The decision comes in light of complaints regarding Trafiksol's SME IPO, which was significantly oversubscribed at a rate of 345.

articles.title: MCX logs record daily turnover of Rs 62.93 lakh crore amid strong activity
articles.content: MCX recorded its highest-ever daily turnover of Rs 62.93 lakh crore on August 28, driven largely by options activity across more than 3.13 crore contracts. The record comes as the exchange strengthens its physical-derivatives market linkage through standardised delivery norms, supporting greater participation, hedging and depth in commodity markets.

articles.title: Paul Black’s 3 thumb rules for identifying great wealth creators
articles.content: Veteran portfolio manager Paul Black’s investment framework focuses on identifying businesses with competitive advantages that strengthen over time. His three key rules emphasise widening moats, strong corporate cultures and improving returns on invested capital, while patience and an information edge can help investors identify and hold potential long-term wealth creators.

articles.title: Silver rebounds from correction: Can the recovery gain momentum?
articles.content: Silver has rebounded sharply from its recent correction, supported by gold’s rally, a weaker US dollar and expectations of stronger industrial demand. While tight supply and growing use in solar, electronics and electric vehicles offer long-term support, shifting monetary policy, global growth concerns and elevated volatility could limit near-term gains.

articles.title: Reliance Jio IPO: 7 risk factors investors should know as firm gets Sebi nod for Rs 37,000-crore issue
articles.content: Reliance Jio’s proposed Rs 37,700-crore IPO has received Sebi approval, bringing the much-awaited listing closer.
